supersedes: g2_design_draft.json (V1, blob 94fdfd29) per independent design review 458c6980 (comment 6400199632, P0-1..4)

cpu_census_carried_forward.note: PASS_CPU_CENSUS_ONLY per the review: construction feasibility, NOT model-confirmed donors, NOT GPU admission

fallback_diff_width_tier.policy: excluded from the confirmatory pool; usable only with explicit per-pair justification at admission

p0_1_qualified_donor_base_rate_and_sizin.denominator_correction: descriptive T2 construction-cohort rate = 2 recognized / 56 constructed T2 appended-conflict cases (20 confirmation-round T2 + 36 V2 T2). The confirmation round's 6 T3 pre-existing-conflict controls are NOT in this denominator. The rounds' strict-eligibility criteria differ, so this is a descriptive construction-cohort rate, not a pooled strict rate.
p0_1_qualified_donor_base_rate_and_sizin.strict_eligibility_stratification: the Stage-A search re-screens every candidate with the same strict criteria (clean old baseline, recognized edited read, valid token-matched neutral reading false) before any qualification count; per-stratum counts reported

sizing_as_probability_not_promise.model: binomial at the descriptive p=2/56, IID assumption (explicitly an approximation; construction strata differ)
sizing_as_probability_not_promise.rule: E[K]=2 does NOT guarantee any qualified donor; the search is sized so P(>=2 new qualified donors) is reported and agreed at admission, and the stop condition 'no new qualified donor' is a live outcome, not a failure of protocol

p0_2_admission_pool_and_full_request_tok.primary_pool: 180 same-width candidates (155 accept / 25 wait, 28 groups); the 9 fallback-diff-width rows are excluded from confirmatory use
p0_2_admission_pool_and_full_request_tok.per_block_width_not_sufficient: same token length of the block label does not prove whole-request alignment; admission per candidate requires the pilot-grade full-request token gate
full_request_token_gate_mandatory: native encode old/new/SA with the frozen BASE tokenizer through the kev encode path; record full-sequence token-ids SHA256
first-divergence appended-span anchors; trailing-suffix (validator_set) token preservation asserted per arm
exact +34 token growth on both new and SA arms (same-width confirmatory tier)
conflicting_vote causal row resolved dynamically from to_record meta; branch-id equality old vs arm per question

p0_3_source_group_independence_tiers.tier1_never_touched_groups: NONE EXIST: the 84-scene used ledger covers all 42/42 DEV run groups; claims of 'run groups never seen by this study line' require corpus data beyond the current 42 groups (future work, not G2)
p0_3_source_group_independence_tiers.tier2_confirmatory_eligible: unused scenes in run groups other than the G5 pilot trio (run-83/run-114/run-182): 172 same-width candidates across 26 groups - worded as 'new scenes and run groups not used by the pilot', never as line-level unseen groups
p0_3_source_group_independence_tiers.tier3_exploratory_only: unused scenes inside the pilot trio's groups (8 same-width candidates) - exploratory additions only, never confirmatory, never counted as replication
p0_3_source_group_independence_tiers.claim_language_rule: G2 results may claim 'replication across new source scenes/groups relative to the pilot'; any stronger independence claim is out of scope without tier-1 data

stage_A_donor_discovery_gpu.content: N candidate pairs x 3 arms (old/new/SA) native forwards + determinism replays; qualification judged from raw logits per the strict criteria
stage_A_donor_discovery_gpu.batching: each run <= 128 hard cap with its own admission receipt and physical ledger; append-only across runs

stage_B_causal_intervention_gpu.gate: only after Stage-A yields >= 2 qualified donors in tier-2 groups with valid token gates
stage_B_causal_intervention_gpu.corrected_formula: F(H, L) = 4 + 4H + 8HL  [3 donor captures + 1 donor NEW baseline + H x (host SA baseline + host SA capture + host NEW capture + identity) + restoration {main + SA-sham + permuted + norm-matched random} H x L + suppression {main + donor-side SA-sham + permuted + norm-matched random} H x L]
stage_B_causal_intervention_gpu.correction_note: V1's 4+5H+5HL omitted the two main intervention arms (2HL) and the restoration norm-matched control (1HL)
stage_B_causal_intervention_gpu.cap: each run <= 128; final counts only from the runner trace on the frozen roster; donor-discovery and intervention stages are separately admitted, reviewed, and authorized

confirmatory_vs_exploratory.confirmatory: layer 11 only; tier-2 same-width candidates; donor-side matched negative controls preregistered; N sized by the probability table
confirmatory_vs_exploratory.exploratory: layer sweep beyond 11 (23 kept as structural-null control), tier-3 scenes, any additional cells - reported without selection, never as replication

controls_unchanged_from_V1: suppression negative controls: host_SA -> donor_new, host_new permuted -> donor_new, norm-matched random -> donor_new (per-pair per-layer same-site pairing, seed frozen at admission)
restoration additions: per-pair span norm / magnitude / activation-distribution quantification; norm-matched random control on the restoration side
key-specific attribution gate: a separate component-controlled K/Q intervention protocol remains required before any Key-only mediation claim
stop_conditions: Stage-A yields no new tier-2 qualified positive donor at the admitted N (live outcome; downgrade/HOLD, no protocol failure)
dual-oracle disagreement on any constructed arm
full-request token gate failure on any admitted candidate
random / SA-sham controls explain the flips as well as the treatment
Key-specific effect does not exceed the cheap norm-matched baseline
gpu_status: NO GPU AUTHORIZED; both stages require narrow design-review PASS, new admission receipts with per-forward traces, and fresh explicit user authorization
